summary: Official warnings state that parts of the packaging combinations containing this drug can cause serious and sometimes fatal allergic reactions, including severe whole-body responses known as anaphylaxis [3]. If these severe allergic reactions happen, the medicine combinations must be stopped [3]. Separately, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high score of 82 for the liver and a low score of 37 for the heart [M].
